text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup. Kitasan Black joins this 
massive carnival carrying the colossal 
mikoshi that is her nation.

"To cheer on Kitasan Black as she faces 
down immense pressure, past winners have 
rushed over to show their support."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, Kitasan, don't let your guard 
down. Make sure you don't end up as prey 
to the spurts of the world's greatest!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Vodka-san! Even if someone tries to 
pass me from behind, I'll grit my teeth 
and hold on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's Supreme Commander" and "Helpful 
Commander" sound similar, don't they? 
Please do your best as Japan's Supreme 
Helpful Commander!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm honored...! I'd be more than 
happy to carry out this duty!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, do your best. Just like how I 
admired the President and won this race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I want to be like Teio-san! Even 
if I can't be as cool as her, I'll run in 
my own way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... My shoulders really do feel 
heavy with the weight. Even though I 
prepared myself for it...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes... When I think about putting on a run 
the world can be proud of, I know I have 
to carry this portable shrine all the way 
through to the very end.

Even for Kitasan Black, who had fought her 
way through countless struggles, carrying 
the mantle of national representative was 
heavy. Even so—
choice_data_list: Anyway, shall we head out to the paddock?
Anyway, let's head out to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right! I shouldn't just stand 
here, I need to head to the paddock...!

Still, I'm sure it will be all right. Yes, 
no matter how heavy a mikoshi shrine it 
may be—
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Kitasaaan!! We're right 
behind you!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is your cheering squad!! 
Today, we fight together!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kitasan! Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... Trainer... this is...
choice_data_list:
Everyone will help carry the portable 
shrine, too.

text_block_list.text:
The cheering never stopped. Yes, so many 
people had witnessed that run in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

The fans captivated by her running grew 
more and more, now swelling into a massive 
surge that helps carry the festival shrine 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I've got everyone with me. 
The ones I want to make smile more than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, I'll take the lead and hype 
up this festival! This festival belongs... 
to all of us right here!"
